# PerchTV 0.1.37

Plex episodes and films from your phone, and lighter captions on Samsung televisions.

## WHAT CHANGED

- Both televisions play a Plex episode or film sent from MobileIPTV. The link to your Plex server is never saved on the television.
- On Samsung televisions, the caption box is only as wide as its words and lets the picture show through behind white letters, and a very long word wraps inside it.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything in 0.1.36: two-line subtitles drawn on two lines, whichever way they spell the break.
